# CHAPTER 55 — THE FIRST BIRTH

## SCENE ONE: LABOR BEGINS BEFORE HABITAT THREE IS FULLY RESTORED

Smoke still clung to the corridors of Habitat Three four days after the fire.

It was a smell nobody could quite place — not quite burnt wire, not quite scorched polymer, something older and more primal that seemed to settle into the throat and refuse to leave. The emergency systems had pulled most of it through the scrubbers, but the residue remained, faint and persistent, like the memory of panic
